note: Query templates are frozen identically for every pilot planning area before any discovery is run, so no area receives a more favourable search than another.

channels.description: tuitioncentres.sg directory, used only through a bounded manual query sample per the source-feasibility verdict; results are discovery leads only, never confirmed evidence.
General permitted web search, used to locate operator-controlled pages; raw result pages/snippets are never persisted.

query_templates.query_text_template: {planning_area_name} Singapore primary school math tuition centre

execution_rule: For each pilot planning area, run every listed template on every listed channel once, in the order listed, and record query text, channel, execution date, an observable result/page count where the tool surfaces one, and whether the query returned zero results. A candidate is any named operator or branch reasonably associated with the planning area; every candidate must then be validated against an operator-controlled page before any evidence status stronger than possible is assigned.
